sources.title: Autumn campaign & Mirlo Club launch plan

units.text: Grow the newsletter list from 1,900 to 3,000 and sell the new single origin, Huila Lot 7, during September and October. The campaign also warms people up for the Club launch on 1 October.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Existing customers in Spain, home brewers aged 25–45, people who follow specialty coffee accounts. Secondary: gift buyers before Christmas.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Autumn, slow mornings, freshly roasted coffee from a small roastery in Valencia. Warm colours, no stock photos.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: One 250 g bag a month, rotating origin chosen by Daniel, a printed brew card and a small surprise from time to time. Whole bean or ground for filter.

units.author: Olga
units.text: Fifteen is a lot for us. Ten?

units.author: Tom
units.text: Ten doesn't move anyone.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Ok, decision: newsletter signups get a code, OTONO15, fifteen percent off the first order. Marta, put it in the welcome email.

units.author: Marta
units.text: Will do.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Club. Price I have at 24 a month. Olga?

units.author: Olga
units.text: I'll check margins with shipping and come back.

units.author: Andrei
units.text: For the checkout I need the price, the billing day and the countries. And whether pause exists.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Pause yes. Countries I want to think about.

units.author: Andrei
units.text: Then I send my estimate for the checkout in writing tomorrow, to Olga.

units.author: Tom
units.text: Budget for ads?

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Four hundred a week in September, we look every Monday.

units.author: Daniel
units.text: Boxes — CajaPack quoted, proof next week.

units.author: Carmen
units.text: Can I also do a little stop-motion for reels? Beans falling into the box.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: If you have time, sure.

units.author: Marta
units.text: Do we have a tone of voice doc?

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Not really. Warm, a bit funny, not hipster.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Okay. I'll write the plan doc by tomorrow. Gracias a todos.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Go/no-go. Let's go through the checklist. Andrei?

units.author: Andrei
units.text: Checkout works on staging, production deploy tomorrow night. Postcode limit, sample product, pause — all there.

units.author: Tom
units.text: Ads: last week at 600, CPC 0.24, 1,240 newsletter signups since the start.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Very good. Marta, emails?

units.author: Marta
units.text: Three emails are ready in the tool. Lucía, you still haven't told me if the welcome text is ok.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: I know, I haven't read it properly. Send me the link again, I'll do it tonight.

units.author: Daniel
units.text: Boxes are here, 500, packing starts on the 30th.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Free shipping. Daniel, did RapidoEnvíos confirm the new rate?

units.author: Daniel
units.text: Not yet. They say by the end of the week. Could stay 4.10, could be 4.60.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Then let's say this: the first Club box ships free, as long as RapidoEnvíos keeps us at 4.10 per parcel. If they move us to 4.60, the first box pays normal shipping like every other box.

units.author: Olga
units.text: Andrei says switching it off is five minutes, so we're safe either way.

units.author: Tom
units.text: One more: landing shows 22 for the Club, the plan says 24. Which one?

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Olga and I will sort it out this week. Leave it as it is for tomorrow.

units.author: Olga
units.text: Yes, we'll talk.

units.author: Carmen
units.text: And the La Espiga giveaway?

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Not now. After launch.

units.author: Lucía
units.text: Anything blocking? No? Then we're GO for 1 October.

units.author: Tom
units.text: Vamos.

units.author: Andrei
units.text: I'll be online tomorrow night for the deploy.
